cases.audit_scope: Original free reply: only two explicitly grouped SKU-colour claims are scored; table: all rows. Not aggregated into main 14-case fact precision.

metrics.fact_precision: Correct returned identity/item/SKU/colour/quantity/status/date rows and explicit scalar/colour claims divided by present claims; no claims => unjudged, not pass. Main 14 and legacy separate.
metrics.task_complete: Exact requested item set plus clarification if requested; count must answer requested unit with no list; short answer <=100 characters and only requested order.
metrics.irrelevant_orders: Distinct displayed order IDs outside requested scope; counts use all source orders as relevant scope, excess list is separately unwanted_rows.
metrics.overwritten_correct: Text changed when frozen correct baseline completed task; harmful subset additionally loses task completion or factuality.
metrics.context: actual next-turn serialized model_input_chars difference, not Tokens

repair_gate.schema_only: All 14 valid-case facts/task/irrelevance/context unchanged from frozen P1; every malformed payload declines without exception or business changes.
repair_gate.routing: Do not trade away any case factuality or completion versus frozen P1 while reducing harmful overrides. A new semantic router is not preauthorized by a keyword match.

sampling: one fixed fake model run per case/arm, two turns; all failures retained; no paid API or model quality inference
